topic: A compilation of satisfying trick shots and flips performed by various groups of friends.

hook.first_frame: Two men standing in a living room holding yo-yo or cord items above a table.

shots.shows: Two men pulling string strings to drop a ring onto a water bottle
A man sitting on a couch throwing playing cards into a spring-loaded trap
A man standing in a hallway while a ghost-costumed figure runs past him
Two men jumping over a bar while hanging clothes
Three men tossing bottles into a tall vertical tube game
Two boys flipping bottles onto a large protein container
Three men on a beach tossing beach chairs and landing bottles in cup holders

text_overlays.text: Profile elimination header with 8 celebrity faces (red Xs on eliminated ones)

ending.last_words: You never know what's gonna happen
ending.last_frame: Three men on a beach celebrating a successful trick shot with a purple shh emoji overlay

script: You see that, you see that, you see that, you see that, you see that, you see that, you see that.
retention_tricks: fast-paced compilation cuts every 3 to 5 seconds
top ranking bar with player profile eliminations
meme emoji reaction face triggers when a trick succeeds
what_makes_it_work: High-energy progression of increasingly impressive trick shots
Celebrity elimination mini-game at the top keeps viewers watching to see who survives
Immediate payoff for every successful trick with celebratory reactions
